title: credential scan has no generic assignment, JWT or OAuth-token class
detail: the eight prefix classes and the LOA_AUDIT_KEY_PASSWORD= pattern miss api_key=/secret=/token: assignments, eyJ… JWTs, ya29. tokens and bare AWS secret keys; the record branch is public; the lead's detect-secrets pass covered this branch; hardening lands with the Sprint 3 lib extraction (brief s3-c)

title: gh_max_buffer_bytes is read from the normal (PR-head-visible) config
detail: bounded 1–512 MiB; raising it affects the reviewer host's memory, never the verdict; documented as memory-only in .loa.config.yaml.example

title: tool-call XML grammar matched at line start only; unclosed fence masks the remainder
detail: a mid-line tag in prose outside code spans passes; an unclosed fence in accepted commentary swallows the coverage section when rendered; the KF-055 transcript was line-start and unfenced; the verdict is unaffected (the block precedes the commentary)

title: --allow-v1 REASON runs the legacy publish path without the ancestry gate
detail: recovery flag; the reason is recorded in the state receipt; the runbook says so (DEC-0868); keep it out of scripted paths

title: section detection reads a heading inside a fenced block as a section boundary
detail: pre-existing index_blocks behaviour; the archive holds the full file; the retained file stays valid markdown

title: systemd mode strips env-borne model credentials from the unit environment
detail: the scrub is correct (systemctl show exposes the unit environment) but undocumented; a supervised batch under systemd-run with env-borne credentials fails every session's auth; this host runs setsid mode; LoadCredential=/EnvironmentFile= are the supported paths

title: .jobs/*.pgid groups killed on the same boot without the start-ticks check
detail: pgid reuse within one boot judged negligible by the implementer; the runner refuses to start while they live

title: refusal_relaunch: a failed hard link logs 'not relaunched' and the outcome is the exclude path, not rerun_not_run
detail: naming only; the row is invalid either way

title: anonymous-row dedup by content across files drops a later file's surplus identical copies
detail: DISS-002 of the review dissent; identical anonymous rows carry timestamps, so a legitimate multiplicity has no producer; a per-file multiplicity guard is a few lines if one appears

title: a model-config.yaml edit needs the lockfile bump and a v3-schema check before pushing
detail: caught by CI on the D2 push (drift gate, M19.3 KF-006 class); fixed in fb54d7947 with the schema extension and regression M19.8; added to the Sprint 3 implementer conventions
